verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a large API with more than 120 actions, a RESTful v2 reference, a sandbox, and an MCP server, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404 on every candidate. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are adjacent features, not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
